narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On May 2, 2024, at approximately 1910 hours, Agents [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] and [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] encountered two men walking along the railroad tracks near Jackson, Michigan. The agents identified themselves and questioned both men in Spanish. Both men stated that they are citizens of Mexico and that they have no immigration documents. Neither man carried identification.
ENTRY:
[REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] stated that he entered the United States in 2010 by crossing the river near Laredo, Texas. [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] stated that he entered in 2018, also near Laredo.
TRAVEL:
Both men stated that they had travelled from Texas to Michigan for farm work.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
Both men were processed for Notices to Appear.
